findings.current: Apparently, it was true that Won Myunghoon had extracted an astronomical settlement from the Star Guild.
findings.defect: The subject is reversed: the settlement was extracted from the Star Guild that Won Myunghoon had led, not extracted by Won Myunghoon from his own Guild.
findings.rationale: The modifier 원명훈이 길드장으로 있던 identifies the Star Guild as the Guild where Won served as Guild Master; it does not make Won the recipient of the settlement.
findings.replacement: Apparently, it was true that the Peace Guild had extracted an astronomical settlement from the Star Guild, where Won Myunghoon had been Guild Master.
findings.source: 원명훈이 길드장으로 있던 스타 길드에서 천문학적인 금액의 합의금을 받아 냈다는 말이 사실인 모양이다.

findings.defect: The draft assigns the creation of the position to Taekyung, while Choi is offering to create one for him.
findings.rationale: Choi follows this by proposing titles and inviting Taekyung to choose one, so the offer is to create a position for him.
findings.replacement: We can always create a position.

findings.current: I clicked my tongue and glanced at one of the open newspapers.
findings.defect: 혀를 내두르다 expresses amazement or astonishment here, whereas “clicked my tongue” suggests annoyance or disapproval.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is marveling at Choi knowing five languages, not expressing irritation with him.
findings.replacement: Shaking my head in amazement, I glanced at one of the open newspapers.
findings.source: 나는 혀를 내두르며 펼쳐져 있는 신문 중 하나를 곁눈질했다.

findings.current: I already spoke to Butler Kim and Song-i this morning. I asked them to take turns teaching the rookies.
findings.defect: The draft turns Choi’s inclusive proposal that they all rotate as instructors into an instruction for Butler Kim and Song-i alone to alternate.
findings.rationale: The quoted proposal 돌아가면서 가르치자고요 uses the inclusive hortative 가르치자, making Choi part of the proposed rotation.
findings.replacement: I already spoke to Butler Kim and Song-i this morning. I suggested that we all take turns teaching the rookies.
findings.source: 안 그래도 오늘 아침에 김 집사님과 송이 씨에게 말해 뒀습니다. 돌아가면서 가르치자고요.

findings.current: I’m not fine with it. You know what happens when you get used to being helped? You get used to shitting yourself during raids, too.
findings.defect: The draft renders the slang 똥 싸다 literally as losing control from fear. In raid slang, it means performing badly or screwing up, which is the consequence Taekyung links to habitual reliance on help.
findings.rationale: “Shitting the bed” preserves both the vulgar register and the intended meaning of repeatedly performing poorly during raids.
findings.replacement: I’m not fine with it. You know what happens if you make a habit of getting help? You make a habit of shitting the bed during raids, too.
findings.source: 내가 안 괜찮아. 그거 알아요? 도움받는 거 버릇되면 레이드 때 똥 싸는 것도 버릇 든다?

findings.current: Get down here, you little bastard…
findings.defect: “Little” loses the explicit age-based insult from the older rookie toward the younger Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 어린노무 directly emphasizes Taekyung’s youth, reinforcing the speaker’s age-based seniority and sudden loss of deference.
findings.replacement: Get down here, you young bastard…

summary: One critical subject reversal changes who received the settlement. Several additional passages alter agency, an inclusive teaching arrangement, an idiomatic warning about poor raid performance, and an age-based insult.
